rules.source_section: INDICATIONS FOR CHEST CT / Follow-Up of Lung Nodules

criteria.description: Incidental solitary or multiple pulmonary nodules identified on recent chest radiograph

required_documentation: Chest X-ray report identifying newly discovered pulmonary nodule requiring CT characterization
rules.review_notes: Diagnostic follow-up of radiographic pulmonary nodule per Fleischner criteria.

rules.source_section: INDICATIONS FOR CHEST CT / Diffuse Lung Disease (DLD) / Interstitial Lung Disease (ILD)
rules.source_quote: For suspected sarcoidosis after initial workup including Chest x-ray

criteria.description: Initial diagnostic workup with baseline chest radiograph completed

required_documentation: Chest X-ray report and clinical evaluation notes detailing respiratory symptoms or lymphadenopathy
rules.review_notes: Diagnostic prerequisite chest X-ray before high-resolution CT for sarcoidosis.

rules.source_section: INDICATIONS FOR CHEST CT / Signs and Symptoms / Hemoptysis

criteria.description: Preceding plain chest radiograph has been completed

required_documentation: Chest radiograph report and clinical notes detailing duration and severity of hemoptysis
rules.review_notes: Chest CT indicated for hemoptysis after chest X-ray completed.
